script: In 1961, Yuri Gagarin became the first person in space. His flight lasted 108 minutes and circled Earth once. He landed by parachute after ejecting from his capsule. As he launched, he shouted 'Let's go!' in Russian. Two years later, Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman in space. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
